Star of Mysore reported on December 1, 2024, that a huge crocodile was sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake near the fishermen's shed between 8:30 am and 9:30 am the previous day. [1] The article mentions that this is not the first time a crocodile has been sighted in the lake and that people have been advised not to get closer to the water. [1] Another article from Star of Mysore, published on January 28, 2026, also reported a crocodile sighting at the bank of Kukkarahalli Lake recently, causing panic among morning walkers. [2] This article states that while the lake is a known crocodile habitat, they are rarely spotted. [2] News18 Kannada and Local18 also reported on September 7, 2023, about a crocodile found in Kukkarahalli Lake. [3] [4] An article from The Hindu on March 26, 2010, reported a giant crocodile spotted on the Kukkarahalli Lake bund, reaffirming the presence of crocodiles in the lake. [5]
